teams.synopsis: Through four weeks Baylen is 2nd in the league in points per week at 127.6, just behind Ben, and has given up the fewest points in the league, so the 2-2 record is selling this team short.
teams.blurb: Here’s the new number one. Baylen came up 1.11 points short against SheLoveQuigs in Week 4, the closest game of the week, and there was basically nothing he could have done about it: his best possible lineup would have scored 110.62, only 2.6 more than he put up. Through four weeks Baylen is 2nd in the league in points per week at 127.6, just behind Ben, and has given up the fewest points in the league, so the 2-2 record is selling this team short. Jaxon Smith-Njigba was quiet with 12.6 points, but Brock Bowers (20.6) and Brock Purdy (19.6) picked up the slack, and that’s the kind of floor you want from your stars. ESPN has Baylen as the highest projected team in Week 5 at 123.5 points against an Anthony team that has dropped in scoring every single week, and Baylen has won the last three meetings between the two. I expect the team to be 3-2 this time next week.

teams.synopsis: Ben is now 3-1, tied for the best record in the league, and leads Preach League in total points despite having the most points scored against him of anyone.
teams.blurb: Well, I said this team felt middling. A$AP Monke responded with 169.73 points in Week 4, the highest score of the season so far and and the best week in franchise history. The old record? 166.06 in Week 3 of 2023, in a loss to Deniz. Ben is now 3-1, tied for the best record in the league, and leads Preach League in total points despite having the most points scored against him of anyone. CeeDee Lamb went for 41.3, Kenneth Walker III added 30.9, and Kyle Monangai put up 28 filling in for Travis Etienne Jr.. That’s a team that can win any week. The only reason Ben isn’t number one? Week 5 looks ugly. ESPN projects the team for only 96.7 points, the lowest in the league, with Kenneth Walker III and Darren Waller on bye and Lamar Jackson projected for zero, so Deshaun Watson gets the nod at QB. Luckily the matchup is Max, who is projected for 96.2.

teams.synopsis: Aidan has scored between 109 and 134 points every week this season, the highest weekly floor in the league, and that consistency is exactly why this team stays in the top three.
teams.blurb: Three Matchup of the Week appearances in four weeks, and this time Aidan came out on top, surviving Baylen by 1.11 points to get to 2-2. Javonte Williams carried the team with 31.3 points while Ja’Marr Chase had a forgettable 5.7. Aidan has scored between 109 and 134 points every week this season, the highest weekly floor in the league, and that consistency is exactly why this team stays in the top three. The one thing I’d clean up is the bench, where Jameson Williams (16.2) and Jordan Love (13.1) would have added another 14.4 points. Week 5 brings Quin, and while ESPN has Aidan as a 120.8 to 106.1 favorite, this matchup is dead even at 3-3 all-time and Quin has won the last two meetings.

teams.synopsis: Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 points, the best single-player performance of the season so far, and Andrew knocked off the number one team in the rankings with 150.45 points, the 4th best week in franchise history.
teams.blurb: Last week I said the Andrew trade to replenish the RB room was a good one. One week later, Kyren Williams put up 36.7 points in his first start for N.Y. Routensss while the two players going the other way combined for 11.7. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 points, the best single-player performance of the season so far, and Andrew knocked off the number one team in the rankings with 150.45 points, the 4th best week in franchise history. He also set that lineup almost perfectly, leaving just 1 point on the bench, the best of anyone in Week 4. The bad news: Week 5 is the Chiefs and Panthers bye, which means no Patrick Mahomes, no Travis Kelce and no Tetairoa McMillan. Aaron Rodgers is the fill-in at QB, Justin Jefferson is projected for 18.5, and ESPN has the team at 109.4 against a 121.0 Ryan squad that has won the last three meetings.

teams.synopsis: Brian Robinson Jr. (25.7) and Romeo Doubs (23.8) both sat on the bench while David Montgomery (4.3) and the Raiders D/ST (0) started, and Charlie left 35.7 points on the bench, the 2nd most in the league in Week 4.
teams.blurb: The throne lasted one week. No Fox Gibbs’en put up 100.78 against Andrew and lost by almost 50, but the frustrating part is what happened on the bench. Brian Robinson Jr. (25.7) and Romeo Doubs (23.8) both sat on the bench while David Montgomery (4.3) and the Raiders D/ST (0) started, and Charlie left 35.7 points on the bench, the 2nd most in the league in Week 4. That depth I keep talking about is real, it just has to make it into the lineup. I’m not panicking. ESPN still projects this team for the most points per week the rest of the season (121.6), and only Ben has an easier projected schedule from here. Chuba Hubbard is on bye in Week 5, but Charlie gets Deniz, a manager he has beaten in four straight regular season meetings. More on that in the Matchup of the Week.

teams.synopsis: My team scored 153.98 points in Week 4, the 2nd highest losing score in Preach League history, behind only Ben’s 166.06 in Week 3 of 2023, and of course it was Ben who handed me this one.
teams.blurb: Yes, I’m moving myself up six spots after a loss, and here’s why. My team scored 153.98 points in Week 4, the 2nd highest losing score in Preach League history, behind only Ben’s 166.06 in Week 3 of 2023, and of course it was Ben who handed me this one. Only Ben scored more than me in Week 4, and I would have beaten every other team in the league by at least 3.5 points. Emanuel Wilson (27.0), Zay Flowers (25.8) and C.J. Stroud (23.1) led the way, and the Omarion Hampton problem is now Anthony’s problem: I sent Omarion Hampton and Parker Washington to Rolls With Butter for D’Andre Swift, Jordan Mason and Jordyn Tyson, and spent $52 of FAAB on Will Shipley. Week 5 is a 3-3 all-time matchup with Carmine, though I’ve won the last three meetings. ESPN has me as the underdog, 114.9 to 121.3, so we’ll see if the new-look RB room can change that.

teams.synopsis: Carmine is 12th in the league in total points and has had the 3rd fewest points scored against him, so a lot of that 3-1 start is the schedule.
teams.blurb: I said the 9th ranking last week was forward thinking, and Carmine delivered: 119.43 points and a win over Brandon to move to 3-1, tied with Ben for the best record in the league. Nico Collins (30.8) and Bijan Robinson (27.7) did the heavy lifting. But here’s the thing, Carmine is 12th in the league in total points and has had the 3rd fewest points scored against him, so a lot of that 3-1 start is the schedule. The team is 28-24 in all-play, a team that should be closer to 2-2. Also, Drake Maye put up 26.2 on the bench while Jared Goff started and scored 20.5, a decision that could matter later. ESPN likes this team in Week 5 at 121.3 projected points against me, but the projected schedule from here is the 2nd hardest in the league, so the record will be tested.

teams.synopsis: Rolls With Butter has gone from 140.31 to 129.07 to 104.16 to 75.47, and that 75.47 was the lowest score of the week, the 4th lowest in franchise history, and a loss to the lowest scoring team in the league.
teams.blurb: Last week I called out that Anthony’s scoring had dropped every week. Week 4 kept the trend going in the worst way. Rolls With Butter has gone from 140.31 to 129.07 to 104.16 to 75.47, and that 75.47 was the lowest score of the week, the 4th lowest in franchise history, and a loss to the lowest scoring team in the league. Josh Allen (18.5) and James Cook III (16.3) were fine, but Courtland Sutton (1.4) and the Bills D/ST (0.8) gave the team nothing, and RJ Harvey scored 19.3 on the bench. Anthony made a move to fix it, trading for Omarion Hampton and Parker Washington, so we’ll see if the change sparks something. It’s a tough spot in Week 5 against the new number one, projected at 106.6 to 123.5, and Baylen has won the last three meetings.

teams.synopsis: Ryan lost by 1.88 points to a team that didn’t start a quarterback, while Ollie Gordon II, his $72 waiver pickup, scored 18 points on the bench and Kenyon Sadiq scored 0 in the FLEX.
teams.blurb: This one hurts. Ryan lost by 1.88 points to a team that didn’t start a quarterback, while Ollie Gordon II, his $72 waiver pickup, scored 18 points on the bench and Kenyon Sadiq scored 0 in the FLEX. The best possible lineup would have scored 129.47, a win by almost 30. Instead, Ryan sits at 1-3, the first time in seven seasons he’s won fewer than two of his first four games. The team is 8th in the league in points per week (112.0), so this isn’t a bottom-of-the-league roster, but the margin for error is shrinking. On the bright side, ESPN projects Ryan for 121.0 in Week 5 against an Andrew team without Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce and Tetairoa McMillan, and Ryan has won five of the seven meetings between the two, including the last three.

teams.synopsis: Deniz picked up the second win of the season in Week 4 to move to 2-2, the 4th time in franchise history the team has won at least two of its first four games.
teams.blurb: I called it. Deniz picked up the second win of the season in Week 4 to move to 2-2, the 4th time in franchise history the team has won at least two of its first four games. It wasn’t quite the boom week I was hoping for, 102.45 points and a 1.23-point win over Cole, but a win is a win. Alvin Kamara (22.8) and Carnell Tate (21.5) led the way, while Bucky Irving only managed 6.1 in that juicy matchup. The team is still 11th in points per week and 20-32 in all-play, so I can’t move them up just yet. Week 5 is a big one though: ESPN projects 120.3 points, nearly even with Charlie, and Deniz has never beaten Charlie in the regular season. More on that in the Matchup of the Week.

teams.synopsis: The Kyren Williams trade has not worked out so far, as Kyren Williams put up 36.7 points for Andrew in his first game on the new team while Harold Fannin Jr. scored 11.7 and Jalen Coker scored 0.
teams.blurb: The Minutemen have scored fewer points every week this season: 118.57, 118.26, 99.52, and now 95.67. The Kyren Williams trade has not worked out so far, as Kyren Williams put up 36.7 points for Andrew in his first game on the new team while Harold Fannin Jr. scored 11.7 and Jalen Coker scored 0. To make matters worse, T.J. Hockenson scored 24.9 on the bench and Brandon left 35.8 points on the bench, the most in the league in Week 4. A better set lineup would have beaten Carmine with room to spare. The team is 2-2, but 9th in points per week and 19-33 in all-play. Week 5 is Cole, a matchup Brandon has lost three straight times, and ESPN has it at 105.2 to 115.2.

teams.synopsis: Cole has scored between 101 and 121 points every week, never really out of a game, but sits at 1-3, with two of those losses coming by a combined 4.89 points.
teams.blurb: So close. Cole lost to Deniz by 1.23 points in Week 4, and it’s the bench that will sting again: Devaughn Vele scored 17.4 points on the bench while Josh Downs (4.6) and TreVeyon Henderson (4.2) started. Cole has scored between 101 and 121 points every week, never really out of a game, but sits at 1-3, with two of those losses coming by a combined 4.89 points. Puka Nacua (27.7) and Sam LaPorta (22.4) did their part. The trade rumors I mentioned last week didn’t turn into anything yet, but the team would benefit from turning some of that bench depth into a starter. Week 5 is a good chance to get back on track against a Brandon team that has dropped in scoring every week, and Cole has won the last three meetings between the two.

teams.synopsis: Max beat Ryan 100.65 to 98.77 in Week 4 without starting a quarterback, while Kirk Cousins (22.6) and Bryce Young (21.5) sat on the bench, only the 2nd time in league history a team has won with an empty QB spot.
teams.blurb: Only in Preach League. Max beat Ryan 100.65 to 98.77 in Week 4 without starting a quarterback, while Kirk Cousins (22.6) and Bryce Young (21.5) sat on the bench, only the 2nd time in league history a team has won with an empty QB spot. The other was Cole in Week 4 of 2022. I said Bryce Young was in for a big week and he was, just not in the lineup. Tee Higgins (26.7) keeps doing his job, but Saquon Barkley put up 2 points and the team is still 13th in points per week (96.2). Max is 2-2, but I’m not buying it yet. Week 5 might be the best chance at a third win though, as Ben is without Kenneth Walker III and the two teams are projected within half a point of each other, 96.2 to 96.7.

teams.synopsis: Quin has the fewest points in the league at 93.8 per week and a 12-40 all-play record, tied for the worst, so I can’t move the team up just because of the record.
teams.blurb: Credit where it’s due. Quin beat Anthony 104.76 to 75.47 in Week 4 and is now 2-2, which ties the franchise’s best start through four weeks. Malik Nabers (23.2), Quinshon Judkins (21.6) and Chase Brown (19.1) all showed up, so maybe the slow start is turning around. Still, Quin has the fewest points in the league at 93.8 per week and a 12-40 all-play record, tied for the worst, so I can’t move the team up just because of the record. Quin also spent $47 on Keon Coleman, who should start right away. Week 5 is Aidan, a matchup that is 3-3 all-time, and Quin has won the last two meetings. ESPN projects 106.1 to 120.8, so it’ll take another upset.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: This week’s Matchup of the Week is the closest projected game of the week, Charlie at 121.3 points against Deniz at 120.3, but the history says it shouldn’t be close at all. Charlie has won all four regular season meetings between the two, by an average of 48.0 points, including 171.30 to 89.52 in 2023 and 153.44 to 91.80 in 2024. Deniz’s only win in this matchup came in the 2020 playoffs. Charlie is coming off a loss with 35.7 points on the bench, and Chuba Hubbard is on bye, while Deniz has the hardest projected schedule in the league from here and needs every win he can get. I think Charlie gets back on track and moves to 3-2, but if Deniz is going to finally break through in this matchup, this is the week.
